risk_note: RV2 by path. The product_pool data source of listPageSectionItems, the feed fall-back to feed.fallback_pool_id, the detail fall-back to the pool price (BR-PRICE-11, TRADE-12) and the pool-refresh job go live; pool_items.commission_rate_bp is written on add, on re-listing and on refresh. A key with a qualifying pool row and no fresh raw id re-parses by title (BR-PROD-05 ③) and reads the pool when the union cannot answer, judged at answer time; other keys keep 30143, tracked as FU-DETAIL-REPARSE. Dedupe of the refresh uses a deterministic job id because pool-refresh is a standard queue. Open: BR-PROD-05 single-flight lock, shop_id filter and query slot are not done. No money moves: pool prices are display quotes and the open re-checks them. Codex was unavailable until 11-02, so tests and reviews ran on fresh independent Claude contexts (approvals id 36).
